name: Electroweak instanton exp(-4 pi/alpha_W), sphaleron E_sph ~ 9 TeV, collider-rate dispute (Tye-Wong vs Bezrukov et al., Khoze-Milne, Funakubo et al.)

source.located: Composite, seven sources, every one READ at source: (1) Rubakov & Shaposhnikov hep-ph/9603208v2, eq.(2.8) at alphaXiv p.7 (the instanton factor); (2) Tye & Wong 1505.03690v3 (PRD 92 045005), abstract p.1, printed p.2 (10^-162 at 1/30), eq.(1.2) printed p.3, U(1) -> 9.0 TeV printed p.4, 'very crude' printed p.5, exp(-2S) at 1/29.7 printed p.7; (3) Funakubo, Fuyuto & Senaha 1612.05431v1, pp.1-5 (eqs (5)-(10) E_sph = 9.08 TeV; p.4 overlap 10^-155 and multi-W 10^-176); (4) Bezrukov, Levkov, Rebbi, Rubakov & Tinyakov hep-ph/0304180v2, abstract p.1, conjecture p.2, model p.3 (theta_W = 0, lambda = 0.125 i.e. M_H = M_W), lower bound p.7, conclusions p.22; and hep-ph/0305300v1 abstract p.1, p.5; (5) Khoze & Milne 2011.07167v1, Tables 1-2 and printed p.9-10, p.13, p.15, p.16; (6) Tye & Wong 1710.07223v1, pp.1-4, 9-11, ref.[27] p.13; (7) CMS 1805.06013v2, abstract p.1, pp.4-5, 19. The classic 't Hooft PRL 37 (1976) 8 behind the instanton factor is NAMED-NOT-READ (seen only as restated by RS96 eq.(2.7)-(2.8), FFS p.1 and Matchev-Verner 2505.05607 p.1/p.12).

This READ lifts, for their loci, the NAMED-NOT-READ of the sibling audits 1612.05431-1505.03690-esph and hep-ph/9603208-instanton.

published_statement: (a) INSTANTON, RS96 eq.(2.7)-(2.8) (alphaXiv p.7): 'The instanton action is S_inst = 8 pi^2/g^2 and the tunnelling amplitude is proportional to A_inst ~ e^{-S_inst}. In the electroweak theory, the tunneling probability is unobservably small, Gamma_inst ~ exp(-4 pi/alpha_W) ~ 10^-170, where alpha_W = g^2/4pi = alpha/sin^2 theta_W = 1/29.' Tye-Wong 1505.03690 printed p.7: 'since an instanton action S = 2 pi/alpha_W where the weak coupling alpha_W ~ 1/29.7, the tunneling rate goes like exp(-2S) ~ 10^-162, which is totally unobservable.' (b) SPHALERON, TW eq.(1.2) printed p.3: 'Using the known Higgs vacuum expectation value v = 246 GeV, W Boson mass m_W = 80 GeV and the Higgs Boson mass m_H = 125 GeV, we obtain V(Q) ~ 4.75 TeV (1.31 sin^2(m_W Q) + 0.60 sin^4(m_W Q)), E_sph = max[V(Q)] = V(pi/2m_W) = 9.11 TeV'; printed p.4: 'turning on the U(1) coupling (i.e., Weinberg angle sin^2 theta_W = 0.23) will lower the sphaleron energy by about a percent. So it is reasonable to use E_sph = 9.0 TeV'. FFS eq.(10): 'E_sph = g_2 v V(pi/2) ~ 9.08 TeV' with beta_1 = 1.313, beta_2 = 0.603 (eq.(8)). (c) COLLIDER RATE. BLRRT hep-ph/0304180 abstract: 'baryon and lepton number violation remains exponentially suppressed up to very high energies of at least 30 sphaleron masses (250 TeV)'; p.2 'This approach is based on the conjecture that, with exponential accuracy, the two-particle initial state can be substituted by a multiparticle one ... (although not proven rigorously ...)'; p.22 'remains highly suppressed up to energies of at least ~250 TeV (and likely much higher)'. Khoze-Milne 2011.07167 printed p.9: 'The instanton suppression factor is significant with the minimal value of the holy-grail function, F ~ 0.70, loosing only 30% of the original 't Hooft instanton suppression ... Electroweak instantons remain exponentially suppressed by at least e^{-(4pi/alpha_w) 0.70} and are unobservable in high energy 2 particle collisions for any value of the energy'; p.13 'while there is no rigorous proof of exponentiation, we are comfortably optimistic'; p.15 'based in part on an assumption that there are no additional exponentially growing ... contributions'. FFS p.4: 'in the leading order of the WKB approximation, the overlap between the coherent state and the n-particle state produces a multiplicative factor ... a suppression factor ~ e^{-pi E_sph/m_W} ~ 10^-155 ... about 80 W bosons ... (1/(4pi)^2)^80 ~ 10^-176 ... Those types of the suppressions still remain regardless of the band structure'. Tye-Wong 1505.03690 abstract: 'baryon-lepton number violating processes can take place without the exponential tunneling suppression (at zero temperature) at energies around and above the barrier height (sphaleron energy) at 9.0 TeV'; 1710.07223 p.1 'there is a discrepancy of about 70 orders of magnitude between the two estimates', p.2 'We agree with this estimate for a single sphaleron. However, we claim that multi-sphaleron processes can drastically change the picture ... It is clear that both estimates involve assumptions based on intuitions as well as approximations remaining to be fully justified', p.3 'the estimate (4) is only an order of magnitude guesstimate'. CMS 1805.06013 abstract: 'An upper limit of 0.021 is set at 95% confidence level on the fraction of all quark-quark interactions above the nominal threshold energy of 9 TeV resulting in the sphaleron transition.'
published_hypotheses: RS96 / instanton: pure Yang-Mills instanton (the Higgs phase has no exact Euclidean solution: 'In theories with the Higgs mechanism there appears a slight complication', alphaXiv p.7); leading semiclassical exponent only, no prefactor ('~'); alpha_W = alpha/sin^2 theta_W = 1/29 (a convention: via alpha and sin^2 theta_W, not via G_F).

TW15 / E_sph: theta_W = 0 and right-handed fermions ignored (printed p.5: 'we ignore the U(1) gauge field (i.e., set Weinberg angle theta_W = 0) and the right-handed fermions'); classical static saddle on Manton's path; inputs v = 246, m_W = 80, m_H = 125 GeV; zero temperature.

TW15 / collider claim: reduction of the field theory to 1-D quantum mechanics in the Chern-Simons coordinate with a constant mass m = 17.1 TeV; Bloch waves of the periodic potential; zero temperature; event count 10^{4+-2} at 14 TeV is 'A very crude order of magnitude estimate'.

FFS / E_sph and rebuttal: U(1)_Y neglected ('the effect of a U(1)_Y contribution on the sphaleron energy is a few %, we neglect it', p.1); gauge-invariant reduced model with A_0; WKB with three connection formulas; the 10^-155 rests on the coherent-state formalism of their Refs.[12,13], 'in the leading order of the WKB approximation'; two-particle in-state with total momentum E_sph; no thermal corrections.

BLRRT / prevalent result: SU(2)-Higgs model 'with theta_W = 0' (p.3); 'lambda = 0.125, which corresponds to M_H = M_W' in most calculations, with 'The dependence on the Higgs boson mass is very weak' asserted (p.3); fields 'restricted to be spherically symmetric', so 'our results apply, strictly speaking, to s-wave scattering only' (p.2); the few-particle conjecture 'although not proven rigorously' (p.2); smooth N -> 0 extrapolation (Khoze-Milne p.16 describe it as 'assuming that it is smooth').

Khoze-Milne: optical-theorem instanton / anti-instanton calculation with initial-state (Mueller) corrections; exponentiation of the Mueller correction assumed ('no rigorous proof', p.13); no additional exponentially growing higher-order contributions assumed ('assume on physical grounds', p.13; restated p.15); pre-exponential factors not computed (p.16).

TW17: multi-sphaleron resonant tunnelling; massless fermions in the QM direction then masses argued to be a slight modification; d ~ 4 effective (B+L)-conserving dimensions ('A somewhat different value of d is also perfectly acceptable to us', p.10); power-like (not exponential) pre-factor assumed.
CMS: 35.9 fb^-1 at 13 TeV; the pre-exponential-factor (PEF) interpretation follows Ellis-Sakurai [49]; nominal E_sph = 9 TeV (also 8 and 10 TeV).

lacked_data: For THIS result the datum most plausibly lacking is the Higgs mass: the prevalent numerical result (BLRRT 2003) was computed at M_H = M_W (hep-ph/0304180 p.3, READ), nine years before m_H = 125 GeV was measured, and the dissent (TW 2015) and rebuttal (FFS 2016) postdate it. EVIDENCE: (i) computed here, the measured m_H raises the barrier B by 5.2 % (1.8208 -> 1.9163), so BLRRT's energy scale in TeV shifts by ~5 %; (ii) BLRRT assert the exponent's m_H dependence is 'very weak' but give no computation for it, and Matchev-Verner 2025 (READ) say the physical m_H modifies the unstable mode 'with important implications for ... collider signatures' without quantifying the collision exponent; (iii) no recomputation of F_HG at the physical m_H was read. So whether the missing datum moves BLRRT's '30 sphaleron masses' is UNKNOWN here -- no evidence either way beyond the 5 % barrier shift. Khoze-Milne (2020) postdate m_H, so they did not lack it. What the other data do, computed: alpha_W 1/29 -> 1/29.49 moves the instanton exponent 2.7 decades of ~161; m_W's moves shift E_sph <= 0.1 % and the FFS overlap exponent <= 0.3 decade. EVIDENCE AGAINST M's hypothesis being the operative issue: the dispute is not data-limited but method-limited -- by both sides' own words (BLRRT p.2 'not proven rigorously'; KM p.13 'no rigorous proof', p.15 'assumption'; FFS 'leading order of the WKB approximation'; TW17 p.2 'assumptions based on intuitions as well as approximations remaining to be fully justified', p.3 'only an order of magnitude guesstimate'). The only experimental datum (CMS 0.021) is above both sides' figures. Having m_H, m_W or alpha_W at today's precision does not resolve which approximation is valid; a controlled first-principles calculation of the two-particle rate would. The tree's conclusion -- CONTESTED, nothing refused on it -- is unchanged by every datum examined.
grade_evidence: What STANDS, READ and computed: (a) exp(-4pi/alpha_W) is the published instanton factor (RS96 eq.(2.8), TW15 p.7), machine-checked as exp(-2 S_inst); the tree's 10^-160.95 at 1/alpha_W = 29.49 reproduces (-160.9489) and is independently confirmed by Matchev-Verner 2025 ('~10^-161'); no moved datum moves it off 'unobservably small'. (b) E_sph ~ 9 TeV is READ at source (TW 9.11 / 9.0, FFS 9.08, Matchev-Verner 9.1, CMS 'approximately 9 TeV') and reproduces at the tree's inputs (9.0818 TeV); '~3.2e3 x 3 baryons' = 3225.8 (3197 with U(1)). (c) CONTESTED is a faithful reading: every verbatim quote the tree carries (massform.py:176-192, 570-613; ledger S11) was string-matched at source; both sides' own hedges are quoted accurately; TW17 does not concede (p.3); CMS decides nothing (computed: 0.021 > 10^-3 > 10^-70). The tree adjudicates nothing and refuses nothing on it (massform.py:612), which is what the evidence supports. WHY NARROWED, not STANDS: the prevalent result the tree quotes holds on a smaller class than stated at the use site -- BLRRT's model has theta_W = 0 (named nowhere in the tree) and M_H = M_W (named only in the SOURCES locator massform.py:1172-1173, not in the prose at 573-578 or in ledger S11), beside the s-wave and conjecture the tree does name; the E_sph value used carries theta_W = 0 unnamed (sibling audit); the alpha_W scheme convention is unnamed (sibling audit). None of these moves any figure S11 prints at its stated precision, and none moves S11's status, because nothing is refused on the collider rate.
